_comment: Size ceilings for the knowledge layer. A ceiling is `limit` + `slack`, not a target: lower it by hand freely, raise it only with `--budget-refresh` after a deliberate decision. `slack` is headroom for content the repo does not author — the machine-owned GitNexus block in AGENTS.md / CLAUDE.md, which `npx gitnexus analyze` rewrites on every reindex. It is per-file only; a tier inherits its members' slack and never gets its own.

_history._comment: Every-session cost, before and after the 2026-09-19 restructure. The old model mandated reading four files (context + decisions + state + system-map) before any major work. `measured` is the actual sum at that commit; `limit` is the tier ceiling recorded at the time.

_targets._comment: Where these should land as content is trimmed further. Not enforced.

globs._comment: ADRs carry the full reasoning behind a decision and legitimately run long; this ceiling only catches a runaway document.

session_start._comment: Loaded at the start of every session, before knowing what the task is.

before_code_change._comment: Added before touching code. Replaces the old 'read four files' mandate.

session_total._comment: Union of the two tiers above. This is the real cost of a coding session.
